tabs.title: Company Overview
tabs.content:
**Lindengate Health** operates a network of nine private hospitals and thirty outpatient clinics. The company recently acquired **Merriview Clinics**, a smaller clinic group that runs its own, completely separate Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) forest with no network connectivity to the Lindengate forest.

**Current Environment:**
- Microsoft Entra tenant: lindengatehealth.org, licensed with Microsoft Entra ID P2
- On-premises AD DS forest **lindengate.local** (11,000 users), currently not synchronized to the cloud
- Acquired AD DS forest **merriview.local** (1,800 users), in a separate datacenter with no trust or VPN to lindengate.local
- A management group **MG-Lindengate** contains all production subscriptions

**Business Requirements:**
- All staff from both forests must sign in to Microsoft 365 and Azure with a single hybrid identity
- Identity infrastructure on-premises must be as lightweight as possible — the security team refuses to operate additional heavyweight sync servers, and the sync layer must survive the loss of any single server
- External collaborators must be reviewed and cleaned up on a fixed schedule

tabs.title: Identity and Governance Detail
tabs.content:
**Hybrid Identity:**
- Password hash synchronization is the approved authentication method
- The two forests cannot be connected to each other; any sync solution must treat them as disconnected islands
- The team wants built-in high availability by simply installing more than one small agent per forest

**External Collaborators:**
- The security group **Grp-ClinicalResearch** contains roughly 200 Microsoft Entra guest users from partner universities and pharmaceutical companies
- Compliance requires that, every three months, the owners of Grp-ClinicalResearch attest to each guest's continued need for access
- Guests whose access is not approved — or whose reviewers do not respond — must lose their membership **automatically**, with no manual follow-up

**Governance Exception:**
- An Azure Policy assignment named **Deny-PublicIP** (effect: Deny) is assigned at the MG-Lindengate management group and blocks creation of public IP addresses
- A telemedicine pilot team has board approval to run a 90-day proof of concept in resource group **RG-TelePilot** that requires public IP addresses
- The Deny-PublicIP assignment itself must **not** be modified, and the exception must expire automatically when the pilot ends and remain visible for audits
